title: Succession — structural placeholder
description: Target-specific establishment of a new attributable predecessor-successor relation, not identity or automatic inheritance.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

predecessor.description: Exact predecessor, kept attributable as predecessor.

successor.description: Exact successor, distinct from the predecessor.

target.description: Exact object, layer, lineage, scope, and Locality of alleged succession.

valid_basis.description: Basis valid apart from the successor's own inheritance claim.

successor_side_establishment.description: Valid acceptance or formation basis for a locally disposing Locality, or an exact establishing occurrence for a Form, State, or artifact.

effective_boundary.description: Exact effective occurrence or temporal boundary.

carry_map.description: The six distinctions of section.17.12; nothing crosses unless expressly and validly carried.

validly_carried.description: What is validly carried into the successor relation, with separate sufficient basis for each claimed effect; Source never transfers.

predecessor_only.description: What remains attributable or applicable only to the predecessor.

refused_excluded_unknown_unresolved.description: What is refused, excluded, unknown, or unresolved, retaining these distinctions.

successor_new.description: What new relation begins only with the successor; any successor Source must be newly attributable.

predecessor_remainder.description: Whether the predecessor ends, becomes dormant, remains historical, continues elsewhere, coexists, or diverges.

establishment_posture.description: Whether succession is established or remains proposed, refused, held, failed, or unresolved, on its exact support.

answerability.description: Predecessor consequences and duties preserved; successor answerability for its own formation, accepted inheritance, exercises, and consequences.
